Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for a vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. New subjects below, not copies of the reference people. Pure WHITE opaque background, no overall paper grain. Each subject must fit within central 80% of its own quadrant with generous margins; NOTHING crosses the horizontal or vertical midlines. Row-major fixed order. Fully contain hands, feet and objects. Avoid illustrating another sense of the word. Fill exactly the specified cells; any unused cell stays blank white. CRITICAL CROP SAFETY: equal cells occupy exactly 0–50% and 50–100% of canvas width/height. Bottom-row drawings start below 55% canvas height. Top-row drawings end above 45% canvas height. TOP RIGHT — surprise (n.惊奇，意外的事): A clear compact educational illustration of 'surprise', specifically its curriculum meaning 'n.惊奇，意外的事'; show a concrete object or minimal human situation that conveys precisely that meaning.
